We introduce VIVA+, a cognitively grounded benchmark for evaluating the reasoning and decision-making of MLLMs in
human-centered situations. VIVA+ consists of… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/zhehuderek/VIVA_Plus_Benchmark.
